title.zh: ZEC’s 100% rally above $1500 sends Grayscale’s Zcash ETF within $85 million of $1 billion
title.en: ZEC’s 100% rally above $1500 sends Grayscale’s Zcash ETF within $85 million of $1 billion

current_state.zh: Grayscale's Zcash ETF (ZCSH) has accumulated $914.53 million in net assets less than a month after its NYSE Arca debut, coinciding with ZEC roughly doubling above $1,500 and futures open interest hitting a record ~$3.5 billion.
